/* selectMasterMpStLongTermStckList */ SELECT DIVISION_NAME , CASE SORT_NO WHEN 1 THEN DEPT_CODE WHEN 2 THEN '' WHEN 3 THEN '' WHEN 4 THEN '' END AS TEAM_CODE , CASE SORT_NO WHEN 1 THEN DEPT_NAME WHEN 2 THEN '합 계' WHEN 3 THEN '전 체 비 중' WHEN 4 THEN '그룹내비중' END AS TEAM_NAME , CASE SORT_NO WHEN 1 THEN TO_CHAR(LONG_A/1000,'999,999,999,999') WHEN 2 THEN TO_CHAR(LONG_A/1000,'999,999,999,999') WHEN 3 THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(LONG_A/TOT_AMT_AB*100,0),'999')||'%' WHEN 4 THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(LONG_A/LONG_AB*100,0),'999')||'%' END AS LONG_A , CASE SORT_NO WHEN 1 THEN TO_CHAR(LONG_B/1000,'999,999,999,999') WHEN 2 THEN TO_CHAR(LONG_B/1000,'999,999,999,999') WHEN 3 THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(LONG_B/TOT_AMT_AB*100,0),'999')||'%' WHEN 4 THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(LONG_B/LONG_AB*100,0),'999')||'%' END AS LONG_B , CASE SORT_NO WHEN 1 THEN TO_CHAR(LONG_AB/1000,'999,999,999,999') WHEN 2 THEN TO_CHAR(LONG_AB/1000,'999,999,999,999') WHEN 3 THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(LONG_AB/TOT_AMT_AB*100,0),'999')||'%' WHEN 4 THEN '' END AS LONG_AB , CASE SORT_NO WHEN 1 THEN TO_CHAR(NORMAL_A/1000,'999,999,999,999') WHEN 2 THEN TO_CHAR(NORMAL_A/1000,'999,999,999,999') WHEN 3 THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(NORMAL_A/TOT_AMT_AB*100,0),'999')||'%' WHEN 4 THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(NORMAL_A/NORMAL_AB*100,0),'999')||'%' END AS NORMAL_A , CASE SORT_NO WHEN 1 THEN TO_CHAR(NORMAL_B/1000,'999,999,999,999') WHEN 2 THEN TO_CHAR(NORMAL_B/1000,'999,999,999,999') WHEN 3 THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(NORMAL_B/TOT_AMT_AB*100,0),'999')||'%' WHEN 4 THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(NORMAL_B/NORMAL_AB*100,0),'999')||'%' END AS NORMAL_B , CASE SORT_NO WHEN 1 THEN TO_CHAR(NORMAL_AB/1000,'999,999,999,999') WHEN 2 THEN TO_CHAR(NORMAL_AB/1000,'999,999,999,999') WHEN 3 THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(NORMAL_AB/TOT_AMT_AB*100,0),'999')||'%' WHEN 4 THEN '' END AS NORMAL_AB , CASE SORT_NO WHEN 1 THEN TO_CHAR(FAULTY_A/1000,'999,999,999,999') WHEN 2 THEN TO_CHAR(FAULTY_A/1000,'999,999,999,999') WHEN 3 THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(FAULTY_A/TOT_AMT_AB*100,0),'999')||'%' WHEN 4 THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(FAULTY_A/decode(FAULTY_AB,0,1,FAULTY_AB)*100,0),'999')||'%' END AS FAULTY_A , CASE SORT_NO WHEN 1 THEN TO_CHAR(FAULTY_B/1000,'999,999,999,999') WHEN 2 THEN TO_CHAR(FAULTY_B/1000,'999,999,999,999') WHEN 3 THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(FAULTY_B/TOT_AMT_AB*100,0),'999')||'%' WHEN 4 THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(FAULTY_B/decode(FAULTY_AB,0,1,FAULTY_AB)*100,0),'999')||'%' END AS FAULTY_B , CASE SORT_NO WHEN 1 THEN TO_CHAR(FAULTY_AB/1000,'999,999,999,999') WHEN 2 THEN TO_CHAR(FAULTY_AB/1000,'999,999,999,999') WHEN 3 THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(FAULTY_AB/TOT_AMT_AB*100,0),'999')||'%' WHEN 4 THEN '' END AS FAULTY_AB , CASE SORT_NO WHEN 1 THEN TO_CHAR(TOT_AMT_A/1000,'999,999,999,999') WHEN 2 THEN TO_CHAR(TOT_AMT_A/1000,'999,999,999,999') WHEN 3 THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(TOT_AMT_A/TOT_AMT_AB*100,0),'999')||'%' WHEN 4 THEN '' END AS TOT_AMT_A , CASE SORT_NO WHEN 1 THEN TO_CHAR(TOT_AMT_B/1000,'999,999,999,999') WHEN 2 THEN TO_CHAR(TOT_AMT_B/1000,'999,999,999,999') WHEN 3 THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(TOT_AMT_B/TOT_AMT_AB*100,0),'999')||'%' WHEN 4 THEN '' END AS TOT_AMT_B , CASE SORT_NO WHEN 1 THEN TO_CHAR(TOT_AMT_AB/1000,'999,999,999,999') WHEN 2 THEN TO_CHAR(TOT_AMT_AB/1000,'999,999,999,999') WHEN 3 THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(TOT_AMT_AB/TOT_AMT_AB*100,0),'999')||'%' WHEN 4 THEN '' END AS TOT_AMT_AB FROM ( SELECT 1 AS SORT_NO , MAX(B.VALUE1) AS SORT_NO2 , MAX((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND TYPE = 'C001' AND CODE = B.TEXT3)) AS DIVISION_NAME , MAX(KEP_DEPT) AS DEPT_CODE , MAX((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND TYPE = 'C001' AND CODE = KEP_DEPT)) AS DEPT_NAME , SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'N' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'A' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'L' THEN STOCK_AMT WHEN A.TYPE = 'F' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'A' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'L' THEN STOCK_AMT * -1 ELSE 0 END ) AS LONG_A , SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'N' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'B' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'L' THEN STOCK_AMT WHEN A.TYPE = 'F' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'B' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'L' THEN STOCK_AMT * -1 ELSE 0 END ) AS LONG_B , SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'N' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'L' THEN STOCK_AMT WHEN A.TYPE = 'F' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'L' THEN STOCK_AMT * -1 ELSE 0 END ) AS LONG_AB , SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'N' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'A' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'N' THEN STOCK_AMT WHEN A.TYPE = 'F' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'A' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'N' THEN STOCK_AMT * -1 ELSE 0 END ) AS NORMAL_A , SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'N' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'B' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'N' THEN STOCK_AMT WHEN A.TYPE = 'F' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'B' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'N' THEN STOCK_AMT * -1 ELSE 0 END ) AS NORMAL_B , SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'N' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'N' THEN STOCK_AMT WHEN A.TYPE = 'F' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'N' THEN STOCK_AMT * -1 ELSE 0 END ) AS NORMAL_AB , SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'F' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'A' THEN STOCK_AMT ELSE 0 END ) AS FAULTY_A , SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'F' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'B' THEN STOCK_AMT ELSE 0 END ) AS FAULTY_B , SUM(DECODE(A.TYPE,'F',STOCK_AMT,0)) AS FAULTY_AB , SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'N' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'A' THEN STOCK_AMT ELSE 0 END ) AS TOT_AMT_A , SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'N' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'B' THEN STOCK_AMT ELSE 0 END ) AS TOT_AMT_B , SUM(decode(A.TYPE,'N',STOCK_AMT,0)) TOT_AMT_AB
FROM KEPSTOCK_MNG A, ICOMCOD1 B WHERE YYYYMM = (SELECT MAX(YYYYMM) FROM KEPSTOCK_MNG) AND A.KEP_DEPT = B.CODE AND B.TYPE = 'TEAM' AND B.FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY KEP_DEPT union all SELECT 1 AS SORT_NO , MAX(B.VALUE1)+1 AS SORT_NO2 , MAX((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND TYPE = 'C001' AND CODE = B.TEXT3)) AS DIVISION_NAME , '' AS DEPT_CODE , '## 소계 ##' AS DEPT_NAME , SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'N' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'A' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'L' THEN STOCK_AMT WHEN A.TYPE = 'F' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'A' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'L' THEN STOCK_AMT * -1 ELSE 0 END ) AS LONG_A , SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'N' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'B' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'L' THEN STOCK_AMT WHEN A.TYPE = 'F' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'B' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'L' THEN STOCK_AMT * -1 ELSE 0 END ) AS LONG_B , SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'N' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'L' THEN STOCK_AMT WHEN A.TYPE = 'F' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'L' THEN STOCK_AMT * -1 ELSE 0 END ) AS LONG_AB , SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'N' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'A' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'N' THEN STOCK_AMT WHEN A.TYPE = 'F' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'A' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'N' THEN STOCK_AMT * -1 ELSE 0 END ) AS NORMAL_A , SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'N' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'B' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'N' THEN STOCK_AMT WHEN A.TYPE = 'F' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'B' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'N' THEN STOCK_AMT * -1 ELSE 0 END ) AS NORMAL_B , SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'N' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'N' THEN STOCK_AMT WHEN A.TYPE = 'F' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'N' THEN STOCK_AMT * -1 ELSE 0 END ) AS NORMAL_AB , SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'F' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'A' THEN STOCK_AMT ELSE 0 END ) AS FAULTY_A , SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'F' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'B' THEN STOCK_AMT ELSE 0 END ) AS FAULTY_B , SUM(DECODE(A.TYPE,'F',STOCK_AMT,0)) AS FAULTY_AB , SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'N' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'A' THEN STOCK_AMT ELSE 0 END ) AS TOT_AMT_A , SUM(CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'N' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'B' THEN STOCK_AMT ELSE 0 END ) AS TOT_AMT_B , SUM(decode(A.TYPE,'N',STOCK_AMT,0)) TOT_AMT_AB
FROM KEPSTOCK_MNG A, ICOMCOD1 B WHERE YYYYMM = (SELECT MAX(YYYYMM) FROM KEPSTOCK_MNG) AND A.KEP_DEPT = B.CODE AND B.TYPE = 'TEAM' AND B.FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY b.text3 UNION ALL SELECT Y.CNT+1,0,X.* FROM ( SELECT ' ' AS DIVISION , '' AS DEPT_CODE , 'A' AS DEPT_NAME , SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'N' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'A' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'L' THEN STOCK_AMT WHEN TYPE = 'F' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'A' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'L' THEN STOCK_AMT * -1 ELSE 0 END ) AS LONG_A , SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'N' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'B' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'L' THEN STOCK_AMT WHEN TYPE = 'F' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'B' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'L' THEN STOCK_AMT * -1 ELSE 0 END ) AS LONG_B , SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'N' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'L' THEN STOCK_AMT WHEN TYPE = 'F' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'L' THEN STOCK_AMT * -1 ELSE 0 END ) AS LONG_AB , SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'N' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'A' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'N' THEN STOCK_AMT WHEN TYPE = 'F' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'A' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'N' THEN STOCK_AMT * -1 ELSE 0 END ) AS NORMAL_A , SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'N' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'B' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'N' THEN STOCK_AMT WHEN TYPE = 'F' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'B' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'N' THEN STOCK_AMT * -1 ELSE 0 END ) AS NORMAL_B , SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'N' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'N' THEN STOCK_AMT WHEN TYPE = 'F' AND STOCK_MNG_CODE = 'N' THEN STOCK_AMT * -1 ELSE 0 END ) AS NORMAL_AB , SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'F' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'A' THEN STOCK_AMT ELSE 0 END ) AS FAULTY_A , SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'F' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'B' THEN STOCK_AMT ELSE 0 END ) AS FAULTY_B , SUM(DECODE(TYPE,'F',STOCK_AMT,0)) AS FAULTY_AB , SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'N' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'A' THEN STOCK_AMT ELSE 0 END ) AS TOT_AMT_A , SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'N' AND STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = 'B' THEN STOCK_AMT ELSE 0 END ) AS TOT_AMT_B , SUM(decode(TYPE,'N',STOCK_AMT,0)) TOT_AMT_AB
FROM KEPSTOCK_MNG WHERE YYYYMM = (SELECT MAX(YYYYMM) FROM KEPSTOCK_MNG)) X, ((SELECT ROWNUM AS CNT FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 3)) Y ORDER BY SORT_NO,SORT_NO2 )
